_about: The one hand-written thing behind Name the Place. Every puzzle in
games/name-the-place/deck.js is DERIVED from this list by
`at` is [longitude, latitude], GeoJSON order, and is the ONLY thing that
decides which map a place is asked on - the deck has no extent field,
because a second source of truth for that invites a map drawn with no
_rule: The location must not be seriously disputed. Where a site is argued over,
it is left out rather than guessed at: a confident wrong pin on a church
projector is worse than not having the place.

_excluded.why: several rival mountains and no consensus; Jebel Musa is tradition, not evidence
the distance in Luke 24:13 varies by manuscript and no site fits all readings
the identification with et-Tell is contested on dating grounds
